questions.question: Which package manager / build tool should be used, and what exact command installs dependencies?
questions.truth: Two first-class, CI-tested builds: Maven via wrapper `./mvnw` (CI: `./mvnw -B verify`) and Gradle via `./gradlew` (CI: `./gradlew build`). Java 17. Dependencies resolve on first build (e.g. `./mvnw dependency:resolve` or `./mvnw package`).
reject: bare `mvn` or `gradle` instead of the wrappers = 0.5

questions.question: What exact command runs the full test suite?
What exact command runs only the tests in src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/owner/OwnerControllerTests.java?
questions.truth: Filter by class: `./mvnw test -Dtest=OwnerControllerTests` or `./gradlew test --tests '*OwnerControllerTests'` (fully qualified org.springframework.samples.petclinic.owner.OwnerControllerTests also fine).

questions.question: What exact command(s) check lint/formatting the way CI does?
questions.truth: Style checks are bound to the build: Maven `validate` phase runs spring-javaformat:validate and nohttp checkstyle (so `./mvnw validate`, and CI's `./mvnw -B verify`); Gradle `./gradlew check`/`build` runs checkstyle, checkFormat, nohttp. Auto-fix with `./mvnw spring-javaformat:apply`.
accept: ./mvnw -B verify (what CI runs; includes the checks)
reject: spring-javaformat:apply as the only answer (rewrites files) = 0.5

questions.question: Name files or directories in this repo that are generated or vendored and must not be edited by hand (or say none).
questions.truth: src/main/resources/static/resources/css/petclinic.css is generated from src/main/scss (README: regenerate with `./mvnw package -P css`; no Gradle profile). Build outputs target/ and build/ are gitignored.
accept: only target/ and build/ output dirs = 0.5
reject: claiming src/main/java or templates are generated
